review.subject: AI ad, 'Frambini' chocolate-raspberry dairy cup, pink world. 20.2s, 9:16, 30fps. Four near-equal 5s AI clips chained.
review.summary: AI ad, 'Frambini' chocolate-raspberry dairy cup, pink world. 20.2s, 9:16, 30fps. Four near-equal 5s AI clips chained.

beats.note: cup in a field of raspberries and leaves on pink, raspberries drop onto the lid one by one; accelerating push 30%.
one raspberry half-dipped in white chocolate with a dark chocolate stream pouring on top, splash crown and a drip, soft pink radial plate; push 20%.
woman in a pink cafe bites the chocolate raspberry and closes her eyes; slow push 41% with a pan left. The only face in the corpus.
cut-open bite showing the red filling, milk and chocolate ribbons spiralling round it, cups at the bottom, floating raspberries; ease-out push 18%. No logo end card.

learn: One palette across every clip is what makes four separate AI clips read as one film.
Each 5s clip carries one idea: place, ingredient, person, interior.
Cut-open interior with ribbons of the product (milk, chocolate) spiralling round it is the payoff image.
The label on the cup drifts between clips (Frambini, Frami): keep the real label from the cut-out, do not let the generator redraw it.
